bugs.title: install.sh + install.ps1 probe for `antigravity` CLI broken on Antigravity 2.0+
bugs.steps: 1. Update Antigravity to 2.0.1 (auto-update may already have happened). 2. Run `scripts/install.sh <vsix>` with Antigravity.app installed. 3. Antigravity is skipped in the summary block (`antigravity SKIP (not on PATH)`) even though Antigravity is present, because the CLI binary was removed in the 2.0 bundle restructure. The old path `/Applications/Antigravity.app/Contents/Resources/app/bin/antigravity` no longer exists; the new `Contents/Resources/bin/` contains only language_server + webm_encoder. The install scripts have no alternative install path for Antigravity (e.g. write to user-extensions dir directly, or document the GUI Install-from-VSIX flow). Discovered during DOS:R5 Phase B/E sessions — earlier DOS:R4 install runs against Antigravity 1.107.0 worked.
bugs.note: Fixed as a diagnostic improvement: install.sh + install.ps1 now detect the Antigravity.app bundle (macOS + Windows paths) when the CLI check fails and emit `SKIP (Antigravity 2.x — CLI removed; install manually via app UI)` instead of the generic `not on PATH`. README troubleshooting block updated with the GUI sideload path. A programmatic fallback (unzip vsix into ~/.antigravity/extensions/) was considered but deferred — introduces a design call about CLI-less editor support more broadly; revisit if Antigravity becomes a dogfooding target. Live-verified against the user's machine (Antigravity 2.0.1 present, CLI absent).

bugs.title: Phase E upgrade-notification e2e: live walkthrough deferred (user stepped away)
bugs.steps: DOS:R5 Phase E set up the conditions for CHUNK-04 § 11.4 verification: v0.0.1 installed in VS Code (internal version 0.0.1), v0.0.2 release tagged + workflow green + assets verified, repo flipped public so the unauthenticated API call returns 200 with tag_name=v0.0.2. The remaining step — reload VS Code window, observe the `DeliveryOS v0.0.2 is available...` notification, click `Open release page` (verify browser opens https://github.com/saifgithub/DeliveryOS/releases/tag/v0.0.2), and separately reset state + click `Don't show again` (verify `deliveryos.checkForUpdates` flips to false) — was not performed because the user stepped away mid-Phase E. Code review of `extension/src/updater/checkForUpdates.ts` confirmed the handlers wire up correctly (lines 113-122). All non-UI checks pass.
bugs.note: When user is back at the computer: (a) Reload VS Code window at /tmp/deliveryos-smoke-r5/ — notification should fire. (b) Click 'Open release page' — browser opens v0.0.2 release URL. (c) Reload again — no notification (lastSeenReleaseTag=v0.0.2 suppression). (d) Reset state by `code --uninstall-extension deliveryos.deliveryos` then `code --install-extension /tmp/release-verify-v2/deliveryos-0.0.1.vsix --force`. (e) Reload — notification re-fires. (f) Click 'Don't show again'. (g) Settings → search 'deliveryos.checkForUpdates' → confirm value is `false`. (h) Reload — no notification. All eight observations needed before marking this bug resolved AND closing CHUNK-04 done-when.

bugs.title: release.yml uses Node.js 20 actions — will break after 2026-09-16 runner deprecation
bugs.steps: `.github/workflows/release.yml` lines 15-21 use `actions/checkout@v4` + `actions/setup-node@v4` with `node-version: '20'`. Both surface a deprecation annotation on every workflow run: Node.js 20 will be forced to Node.js 24 from 2026-06-02 and removed entirely from the runner on 2026-09-16. The build still works today but the warning rides every release.
bugs.note: Fixed by bumping actions/checkout + actions/setup-node @v4 → @v5 and node-version 20 → 22 (LTS). Verification deferred: the workflow only runs when a v* tag is pushed, so live verification will happen on the next release tag — fix is mechanical enough that local typecheck isn't applicable.

bugs.title: Raw idea textarea too small — does not auto-size to panel
bugs.steps: Open the Raw Idea panel in the DISCOVER stage. The textarea for entering the raw idea is small and fixed-size — does not expand to fill the available panel height/width. Discovered during DOS:P6 dogfood run (B-001/B-002 arc).
bugs.note: Textarea should grow to fill available panel space (flex-grow or height: 100%). Low effort CSS fix.

bugs.title: Save idea overwrites existing raw idea without warning
bugs.steps: Open the Raw Idea panel when a raw idea already exists. Type new content and click Save. The existing raw idea is silently overwritten with no confirmation prompt. Discovered during DOS:P6 dogfood run.
bugs.note: Should show a confirmation dialog ('You already have a raw idea saved. Overwrite it?') before replacing existing content.

bugs.title: Clicking 'Discovery interview' tree item does nothing when Discover panel already open
bugs.steps: Open the Discover panel (Raw Idea tab visible). Click 'Discovery interview' in the DISCOVER tree. Nothing happens — panel does not switch to the answers tab. broadcastDiscoverMode is called but the webview does not respond when panel is already focused. Discovered during DOS:P6 dogfood run.
bugs.note: Likely the webview message listener for discoverMode is not firing when panel is already active/visible. Check broadcastDiscoverMode handler in the webview.

bugs.title: Requirements tree item does nothing when clicked — decompose panel not reachable from sidebar
bugs.steps: In the sidebar, expand DEFINE. Click 'Requirements (not started)'. Nothing happens — no panel opens, no prompt. The decompose panel exists ('DeliveryOS: Decompose PRD into Requirements' in command palette) but has no sidebar affordance. User has no way to discover this without already knowing the command name. Discovered during DOS:P7 dogfood run.
bugs.note: Fixed outside sm-fix-bugs worktree flow during DOS:P7 — code fix shipped in 81c286f; bugs.json status updated retroactively in DOS:P8.

bugs.title: Approve PRD button is a dead end — no navigation or state write
bugs.steps: Fill all 8 PRD sections. Click 'Approve PRD'. A toast appears: 'PRD approved — proceed to Requirements.' Nothing else happens — no DB flag written, no navigation to DEFINE, no sidebar update. User has no affordance to know what to do next. Discovered during DOS:P7 dogfood run.
bugs.note: Options: (1) write an approvedAt timestamp to the PRD row in memory.sqlite, update sidebar to show PRD as approved (checkmark), and show a prompt/button to open Requirements decomposition. (2) At minimum, make the toast actionable — add a 'Go to Requirements' link. The sidebar DEFINE > Requirements item should be the next natural click.

bugs.title: PRD section editors auto-save with no explicit Save button — non-obvious to users
bugs.steps: Open the PRD Editor panel (DEFINE → Draft PRD). The section textareas are editable and auto-save 500ms after typing stops, but there is no visible Save button. Users assume the fields are read-only and look for a Save action. The 'Saved' indicator appears briefly in the section header but is easy to miss. Discovered during DOS:P7 dogfood run.
bugs.note: Options: (1) add a visible 'Save' button that triggers the same debounced save and shows state inline, or (2) make the auto-save indicator more prominent / persistent until user moves away. Auto-save is correct behaviour; the UX gap is discoverability.

bugs.title: Answers tab — answer text boxes constrained width, not full panel width
bugs.steps: Open the Discover panel, Answers tab, after saving discovery answers. Each answer box has a constrained width rather than spanning the full available width of the panel. Discovered during DOS:P7 dogfood run (B-002 discovery answers pasted).
bugs.note: Answer boxes should use 100% / dynamic width to fill the panel. CSS fix — likely missing width: 100% or box-sizing: border-box on the answer input/textarea elements.

bugs.title: Discovery prompt header hardcodes 'DeliveryOS' regardless of project
bugs.steps: Open any project in DeliveryOS, enter a raw idea, go to the Prompt tab. The generated prompt header reads 'Discovery Interview — DeliveryOS' and the Role section says 'for a small software project' — both are static strings that do not adapt to the actual project context. Discovered during DOS:P6 dogfood run.
bugs.note: Minor: the project title is injected into the body correctly but the top-level heading and role framing are hardcoded in promptBuilder.ts. Broader direction: replace static Q&A template with a dynamic AI-driven interview (see BACKLOG.md B-005 — grill-me pattern, ref https://github.com/mattpocock/skills).
